description:
Located in Jacksonville, Texas this mansion was built by President Roosevelt’s Freemason architect almost a century ago. As a lifelong builder, I’ve always been curious about the Freemasons given their timeless building abilities and finally got the chance to walk one with @RITUALTEXASOFFICIAL & @dr.parkinstine. 

This place spoke to me in symbols, math and number, even from the outside. There are multiple windows designed to allow light to illuminate a certain shape at a certain time of day. This is next level construction, and I was humbled after spending an afternoon walking through here.

I still do not know much about the Freemasons, but will admit they are better builders than I. I have so much to learn 🏯👁️🙇 #joefelz #freemasons #building #oldhouse #historichomes #historicbuildings #architecture #construction #symbols #symbolism #learning #secrets #design #walkthrough #constructionlife #studentoflife #truthseeker #respect
creator: joe felz, Parker Edmondson, RITUAL
